ITEM.PTXT: When the mechanical key is inserted into the driver door key cylinder and turned to the lock <unlock> side, the door lock control switch (for key-linked operation) turns ON to the lock <unlock> side.
As a result, the driver door key-linked lock <unlock> switch signal is sent to the main body ECU, and all doors are locked <unlocked> in the same way as with manual lock <unlock> operation.
